|game_text='''Front (frozen) side'''

Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize is a Dark Side card and is a persona of Luke only while on table. Plays only during start of game by revealing from outside your deck if Your Destiny is on table and suspended; deploy to Throne Room as a frozen captive. If not revealed, place under your Starting Effect. While this side up, Bring Him Before Me may not flip. May not be escorted. Flip this card if Vader here and not escorting a captive. Place out of play if released or about to leave table.

'''Back side'''

Immediately 'thaw' Luke (Luke is non-frozen, captured, and seized by Vader). While this side up, subtracts 3 from attempts to cross Luke over (even while a captive). Place out of play if released or about to leave table.

'''What changed:''' both sides re-made at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels) with errata text and the errata mark “E1”: the front side now begins “Luke Skywalker, The Emperor's Prize is a Dark Side card and is a persona of Luke only while on table” and plays “only during start of game by revealing from outside your deck” (if not revealed, placed under your Starting Effect) instead of not counting toward the deck limit and deploying if Bring Him Before Me is on table; “Flip this card if Vader present” → “if Vader here”; back side: “(Luke is a non-frozen captive escorted by Vader)” → “(Luke is non-frozen, captured, and seized by Vader)”; margins lose their uniqueness dot. The PC card data (swccg-card-json) still has the 2018 wording; the words printed on the card image are used here (Bill, 12 Nov 2026 18:51). A visible change, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: front (frozen) side: errata mark “E1”, bottom margin “The Emperor’s Prize”; back side: errata mark “E1”, bottom margin “The Emperor’s Prize”. It is the current printing.
Texts of each version: see the game text on each version's page.
